gates.description: KiCad native refill/ERC/DRC and matched manufacturing exports have not run for the current electrical source. Fixed-copper geometry screens pass.
gates.closure_action: Run the bundled job with KiCad 9.0.9 and pcbnew; resolve findings and regenerate matched exports and hashes. Older Gerbers do not represent this revision.

gates.description: Firmware 2.1.4 passes host and source checks; no current target ELF/BIN or flashed unit exists.
gates.closure_action: Run the pinned Arduino CLI 1.3.1, ESP32 core 3.3.6 and NimBLE 2.3.6 build; verify target drivers, timing, image identity and programming records.

gates.description: T01 is dimensioned, but current copper, interlayer and package heat transfer has not established full-load margin. The ideal 96 µm copper screen exceeds the C206-region 125°C limit.
gates.closure_action: Extract the actual copper/package thermal network; establish local component and module limits against the landing/air bounds, or revise cooling, power or the allowed environment.

gates.description: Finite regulator, rail and oil models are source-bound estimates with explicit component and private-die assumptions.
gates.closure_action: Correlate unpublished regulator control/delay, private return and transient pin behavior with the declared bounds. R158 startup-pulse energy needs supplier or thermal-model correlation.

gates.description: ASC mapping is documented; actual switched fused power, return endpoints, unintended bonds and vehicle traffic remain unobserved. The updated CAN branch model retains sub-6 ns threshold recrossings in 196 deliberately fast-edge cases; receiver filtering and actual source edges are not established.
gates.closure_action: Confirm the fused switched accessory feed and the single full-current F1.1 return; leave F1.2 unpopulated in the harness. Apply the controlled relaxed exit, bonding and profile conditions; compare actual vehicle frames with the controlled ASC profile. Bound the actual CAN edge and receiver response against the retained fast-edge finding, or revise the branch.

gates.description: Adafruit adapter and GPS puck product types are confirmed; PID 851 and PID 960 remain inferred identities.
gates.closure_action: Bind actual labels or order records to connector type, frequency, bias current, temperature and mechanical requirements.

gates.description: Corrected part, land and assembly records exist; actual JLC construction, 13 filled/capped vias, assembly profiles and lot acceptance do not.
gates.closure_action: Confirm finished stackup, copper and mask; the 13-via list; compatible global and local solder profiles; and the exact receiving and handling conditions before production.

gates.description: CAD continuity and isolation screens describe the intended copper. Physical plating, solder, crimps, contacts and population remain unmeasured.
gates.closure_action: Perform continuity and isolation against the current netlist, terminal crimp and pull checks, first-article population review and unit identity checks.

gates.description: RF and field/port models provide bounded estimates. Fast ESD return and trigger bounds remain material and installed performance is unobserved.
gates.closure_action: Satisfy the calculated parasitic and source-current bounds or revise protection; correlate installed RF noise, C/N0, radio and ADC coupling, and accessible-port behavior.

gates.description: Carrier/contact geometry and critical tie calculations are complete. Primary maximum-height bounds cover all 153 fitted references. Complete populated solids, mated accessories, installed fit and retained cable grip are not established; 18 model references remain missing.
gates.closure_action: Check populated clearances and service access against current CAD; confirm clamp materials, retained tension, friction, thermal landing and installed retention.

gates.description: Actual oil response, GPS availability, phone/OS behavior, sustained operation and environmental acceptance remain unobserved.
gates.closure_action: Apply the source-bound acceptance plan to an actual unit. Simulation does not establish lifetime or detection of every in-range stuck sensor.
